text:
emma: Morning team — auditor_michael requested packaged evidence for the recent RBAC policy change and KMS usage around the 2026-10-02 rollout. I want to confirm what slices we should include in the export.

auditor_michael: Hi Emma — we want: the RBAC change diff, approval PR + approvers, CI/CD deploy trace, kube audit events that show RoleBinding changes, KMS Encrypt/Decrypt events for the deploy, and a deterministic sampling README. Keep PII obfuscated but provide a stable hash mapping.

tony: I can export:
- cluster rolebinding diffs (aggregated JSON)
- CloudTrail KMS logs filtered for Encrypt/Decrypt with key-id and request-id
- CI pipeline run metadata (git sha, who approved)
We'll include a mapping file with salted sha256 for principals.

emma: Auditors asked for KMS envelope IDs and key versions tied to deploy timestamp. Tony, can your export show envelope metadata from the secrets manager or S3 envelope headers?

tony: Yes. Our envelope metadata is stored in S3 object metadata for each artifact; it contains envelope_id and key_version. CloudTrail includes the KMS key-id but not envelope id, so we'll correlate by S3 object request-id and CI artifact IDs.

jamie: For RBAC we have pre/post snapshots. I'll produce a diff and also include the raw per-namespace yamls in case they ask for granularity. We'll run the scrub script and generate checksums.

compliance-bot: Reminder: use approved export workflow `./scripts/export_for_audit.sh --profile=audit --salt=YYYYMMDD-<team>` and sign bundle with our internal GPG key. See runbook v3.

laura: Also include chain-of-custody: who created the bundle, S3 presign link, expiry, and ticket ID that authorized the export. I'll add a one-page cover letter mapping ISO control A.9 and SOC2 CC6 to the artifacts.

auditor_michael: Two clarifications: 1) The hash mapping must be reproducible; provide the salt and command used to hash. 2) For the KMS key usage evidence we need request IDs, key_version, and envelope_id for every Encrypt/Decrypt event that falls inside the +/- 48h window of the deploy.

tony: Understood. We'll include a CSV: `timestamp,cloudtrail_request_id,kms_key_id,key_version,envelope_id,principal_hash`. We'll also attach the command used to compute the hash: `echo -n \"user@redwood\" | sha256sum --binary | awk '{print $1}'` plus the salt concat step.

emma: On the sampling README: auditors want deterministic queries they can re-run. We'll include exact AWS CLI commands and jq filters with epoch ranges. Example we'll provide: 
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Encrypt --start-time 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-10-04T23:59:59Z --query 'Events[].{Time:EventTime,Id:EventId,Req:CloudTrailEvent}' > kms_encrypt_events.json
```
And the jq pipeline we used to extract `requestID` and `keyId`.

jamie: Also including vuln triage note: we opened a ticket for CVE-2026-0421 (container-runtime sidecar) discovered 2026-10-01. Patch PR #4321 merged 2026-10-03. I'll include the triage summary and the rollback log (no rollback performed, patch deployed).

auditor_michael: Good — please flag any overlapping timelines between the RBAC change and the vulnerability. We may want to sample additional sessions if they overlap.

laura: Packaging plan: tar.gz bundle with manifest `bundle.manifest` containing SHA256 checksums, signing sig `bundle.manifest.sig`, and `README_sampling.md` with exact commands and the salt. Will upload to s3://redwood-compliance/exports/1909876543/ with 7-day presign.

compliance-bot: Export policy check passed for ticket #INC-2026-718. Remember to redact pod logs with PII using `tools/redact_pii.py` before adding raw yamls.

tony: I'll correlate CloudTrail KMS events to S3 envelope metadata and annotate the CSV with the s3_object_key we used. ETA for upload ~3h.

emma: Once uploaded, we'll DM presigned URL and the salt (out of band) to auditor_michael. Anything else required?

auditor_michael: Please include a short note in the README describing sampling rationale (why this 48h window, randomness seeds if any) and the exact git commit for the CI pipeline that produced artifacts. That will be enough to reproduce our verification. Thanks.

emma: Great. Closing here — we'll flag if auditor asks follow-ups after review.
